2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Saros will start vs. Utah on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Saros narrowly missed out on a shutout in his previous game, allowing a goal in the final minute of a 20-save performance (.952 SV%) in a 3-1 win over the Dallas Stars. After a couple of concerning seasons, the 31-year-old Finnish goalie seems to have returned to elite form. He has a stellar 1.71 GAA and .940 SV% in his last eight games (6-2-0).
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Vejmelka will start vs. Nashville on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: The Mammoth have alternated goalies in recent weeks, hoping one of Karel Vejmelka or Sebastian Cossa can take the reins. Still, neither has been able to perform consistently. The 30-year-old Vejmelka wasn't spectacular in his previous game, but he secured a 4-3 win over the Minnesota Wild, saving 22 of 25 shots (.880 SV%). The win snapped a six-game losing streak for Vejmelka (0-4-2). Utah enters Friday's game as -114 road favourites against the Nashville Predators.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Allen will start vs. Calgary on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Jake Allen was relied upon heavily by the Devils to start the 2026-27 season, but since the acquisition of Connor Hellebuyck, Allen hasn't played much. The 36-year-old Allen last played on November 21st, relieving Hellebuyck and allowing four goals on 16 shots (.750 SV%) in a 9-6 loss to the St. Louis Blues. Since Hellebuyck joined the Devils, Allen has a 4.17 GAA and .852 SV% in four games (1-3-0). Still, the Devils enter Friday's matinée as sizeable -242 home favourites against the Calgary Flames, who snapped a three-game losing streak on Wednesday with a 6-3 win over the Pittsburgh Penguins.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Cooley will start in New Jersey on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Cooley was playing the best hockey of his NHL career before suffering a lower-body injury that sidelined him for over a week in late October. That said, Dustin Wolf has played better since then, taking the reins in the Calgary crease, but Cooley is coming off a solid outing, despite a 2-1 loss to the Ottawa Senators, saving 29 of 31 shots (.935 SV%). That said, the Flames enter Friday's game as sizeable +205 road underdogs against the New Jersey Devils.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Swayman will start vs. Toronto on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Swayman had a tremendous start to the 2026-27 season, posting a stellar 1.85 GAA and .934 SV% in his first seven games (6-1-0). That said, the 28-year-old American goalie has battled some adversity in the weeks since, posting a subpar 3.22 GAA and .879 SV% in his last 10 games (5-5-1). The Bruins enter Friday's game as -148 home favourites against a Toronto Maple Leafs team coming off a 4-2 win over the New York Islanders.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Stolarz will start in Boston on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: When the Maple Leafs signed Bobrovsky to a three-year, $7 million AAV contract ($21M total) in the offseason, the hope was that he could solidify their crease and return the team to the postseason. That said, Bobrovsky has played poorly, so Stolarz will return to the crease on Friday for the fifth time in six games. The 32-year-old Stolarz played well in his most recent game, helping the Maple Leafs snap a miserable nine-game losing streak (0-8-1), saving 20 of 22 shots (.909 SV%) in a 4-2 win over the New York Islanders. The Maple Leafs enter Friday's game as +146 road underdogs against the Boston Bruins, who have scored two or fewer goals in four of their past six games (2-4-0).

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Hofer will start vs. Dallas on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hofer has emerged as the undisputed number-one goalie in St. Louis and has been consistent on most nights. He was solid in his most recent outing, saving 27 of 29 shots (.931 SV%) in a 3-2 shootout loss to the New York Islanders. The 26-year-old goalie has had an outstanding November, posting a 2.20 GAA and .925 SV% in eight games (4-3-1). The Blues enter Friday's game as +111 home underdogs against the Dallas Stars.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: DeSmith will start in St. Louis on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: DeSmith won a career-high 15 games last season and emerged as one of the NHL's most reliable backup goalies, but he has been used sparingly to start the 2026-27 season. That said, the 35-year-old DeSmith was stellar in his most recent outing, saving 25 of 26 shots (.962 SV%) in a 2-1 overtime win over the Florida Panthers. The Stars enter Friday's game as -131 road favourites against the St. Louis Blues.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Thompson will start vs. Florida on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Over the past two seasons, Thompson quietly became one of the NHL's most consistent and reliable goalies, coming off consecutive 31-win campaigns. That said, the 29-year-old goalie has been flat-out unreliable through the quarter-mark of the 2026-27 season. In 16 games this season (8-6-0), Thompson has allowed three or more goals 11 times. The Capitals enter Friday's game as slight -101 home underdogs against the Florida Panthers.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Markstrom will start in Washington on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Markstrom hasn't had to be spectacular this season, but he has done enough on most nights to help his team secure victories. The 36-year-old Swedish goalie allowed three goals on 28 shots (.893 SV%) in his most recent game, a 5-3 win over the Ottawa Senators. He has allowed three or more goals in nine of 14 games this season, but still has a solid 8-4-1 record. The Panthers enter Friday's game as -108 road favourites against the Washington Capitals.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Hildeby will start vs. Ottawa on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hildeby has been used sparingly this season but has been reliable on most nights, winning four of six outings (4-1-1). That said, he struggled in his most recent outing, allowing five goals on 27 shots (.815 SV%) in a 6-2 loss to the Buffalo Sabres. Tampa Bay enters Friday’s game as -132 home favourites against the Ottawa Senators.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Ullmark will start in Tampa Bay on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Ullmark has been outstanding this season, but is coming off his worst performance so far, allowing four goals on 31 shots (.871 SV%) in a 5-3 loss to the Florida Panthers. It was the first time in 14 games that Ullmark has allowed more than three goals. Despite the recent blip, the 33-year-old Swedish goalie is still sporting an absurd 1.63 GAA and .935 SV% in 14 games (12-2-0). The Senators enter Friday's game as +135 road underdogs against the Tampa Bay Lightning.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Vladar will start vs. Vancouver on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Flyers have relied a bit more heavily on Joseph Woll in recent weeks, but he is coming off a poor performance, so they will revert to Vladar on Friday. The 29-year-old Vladar has played only once in the past 12 days, but it was a solid outing, saving 20 of 23 shots (.870 SV%) in a 4-3 win over the Minnesota Wild. The Flyers enter Friday's game as sizeable -225 home favourites against the Vancouver Canucks.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Merilainen will start in Philadelphia on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Merilainen has been far from stellar this season and has struggled at times, but he has been more reliable than Kevin Lankinen, who has been abysmal. The 24-year-old Merilainen allowed five goals on 26 shots (.808 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 5-1 loss to the Detroit Red Wings. He has allowed three or more goals in 15 of his last 16 games (3-11-1). The Canucks enter Friday's game as +199 road underdogs against the Philadelphia Flyers.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Greaves will start on Friday vs. Detroit.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Greaves hasn't played much in recent weeks, but will return to the crease on Friday. The 25-year-old Greaves had a tremendous first full NHL season in 2025-26, posting a 2.60 GAA and .908 SV% in 55 games (26-19-9), but hasn't had that same success in 2026-27. Greaves has lost eight of 10 starts this season (2-8-0) while allowing a concerning three or more goals eight times. The Blue Jackets enter Friday's game as -125 home favourites against a Detroit Red Wings team coming off a 5-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Gibson will start in Columbus on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: The Red Wings have relied, deservedly so, on Daniil Tarasov in recent weeks, but they will turn to Gibson on Friday. The 33-year-old Gibson has only played once in the past two weeks, a 19-save performance (.864 SV%) in a 3-2 loss to the New York Islanders. He has allowed three or more goals in 11 of his last 13 games (4-8-1). The Red Wings enter Friday's contest as +115 road underdogs against the Columbus Blue Jackets.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Wallstedt will start in Colorado on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Filip Gustavsson returned earlier this week, but the team seems comfortable continuing to lean on Wallstedt, who has deservedly been the NHL's busiest goalie this season. That said, Wallstedt is coming off one of his weakest performances of the season, allowing four goals on 21 shots (.810 SV%) in a 4-3 loss to the Utah Mammoth. Minnesota enters Friday's game as slight -112 home favourites against the Colorado Avalanche.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Blackwood will start vs. Minnesota on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Scott Wedgewood recorded a shutout in his most recent game, arguably his first strong performance of the season, but in consecutive games since, Colorado will return to Blackwood, who has been their go-to guy all season. The 29-year-old Blackwood is coming off a 28-save outing for his second shutout of the season, a dominant 6-0 win over the Montreal Canadiens. The Avalanche enter Friday's game as slight +102 road underdogs against the Minnesota Wild.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Brossoit will start vs. Los Angeles on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Brossoit had a successful stint with the Ducks earlier this month, but was surprisingly sent down to San Diego (AHL) after a 4-2 loss to the Nashville Predators on November 11th, when he allowed four goals on 22 shots (.818 SV%). In his return to action on Wednesday, Brossoit made a strong case for staying in the NHL, recording the Ducks' first shutout of the season with 23 saves in a 7-0 win over the San Jose Sharks. The Ducks enter Friday's game as slight -104 home underdogs against the Los Angeles Kings, who are coming off a 2-1 win over the Montreal Canadiens.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Kuemper will start in Anaheim on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Kuemper has been far from stellar this season, but through 22 games, he remains the only goalie with a win for the Kings. That said, the 36-year-old veteran goalie saved 29 of 30 shots (.967 SV%) in his most recent game, a 2-1 win over the Montreal Canadiens. He has won three straight games while saving 82 of 86 shots (.953 SV%). The Kings enter Friday's game as slight -113 road favourites against the Anaheim Ducks.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Askarov will start vs. Vegas on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Askarov was serviceable in his most recent game, saving 26 of 29 shots (.897 SV%), but his team fell to a 5-2 loss to the Minnesota Wild. The 24-year-old Russian goalie has been far from spectacular this season, but has given his team a chance more often than not. In his last 14 games, Askarov has played much better than his 4-7-1 record suggests, posting a 2.97 GAA and .903 SV%. The Sharks enter Friday's game as +179 home underdogs against the Vegas Golden Knights.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Hart will start vs. San Jose on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Hart has won four of his last five (4-1-0) but has been far from stellar, allowing three or more goals in four of those games. The 28-year-old goalie allowed four goals on 24 shots (.875 SV%) in his most recent game, a 5-3 win over the Edmonton Oilers. The Golden Knights enter Friday’s game as sizeable -206 road favourites against the San Jose Sharks.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Knight will start vs. New York on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After a solid inaugural full season with Chicago in 2025-26, posting a 2.82 GAA and .902 SV% in 55 games (19-25-11), Knight has struggled in 2026-27. That said, he's in his best stretch of the season, winning three of his last four (3-1-0), posting a 2.47 GAA and .924 SV%. The Blackhawks enter Friday's game as +153 home underdogs against the New York Rangers.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Garand will start in Chicago on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Despite losing 5-2 to the Carolina Hurricanes in his most recent outing, Garand was solid, saving 36 of 40 shots (.900 SV%). The 24-year-old rookie goalie has allowed three or fewer goals in six of his last seven games (3-4-0), posting a solid .919 SV%. The Rangers enter Friday's game as -178 road favourites against the Chicago Blackhawks.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Varlamov will start vs. Winnipeg on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After missing the entire 2025-26 season due to an injury, Varlamov's return to the crease in 2026-27 has been inconsistent. The veteran 38-year-old goalie struggled in his most recent outing, allowing four goals on 22 shots (.818 SV%) in a 4-3 overtime loss to the Winnipeg Jets. That said, he has helped his team record a point in six of his last seven games (2-1-3). The Islanders enter Friday's game as -117 home favourites in a rematch against the Jets, who are 9-1-1 in their past 11 games.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Skinner will start on Long Island on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: The Jets' high-octane offence in recent weeks has masked some inconsistent goaltending, as the team continues to win during a hot 11-game stretch (9-1-1). That said, Skinner was stellar in his previous outing, saving 33 of 35 shots (.943 SV%) in a 4-2 win over the Utah Mammoth. The 28-year-old goalie has won six of his last eight games (6-1-1) despite a pedestrian 3.10 GAA and .888 SV%. The Jets enter Friday's action as +105 road underdogs against the New York Islanders, who are coming off a 3-2 shootout win over the St. Louis Blues.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Luukkonen will start vs. Pittsburgh on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After receiving unreliable goaltending from Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen and Colten Ellis, the Sabres were desperately awaiting Alex Lyon's debut in November after recovering from an injury. That said, Lyon has not been the answer, but Luukkonen has surprisingly elevated his game since. Luukkonen was stellar in his most recent outing, saving 29 of 30 shots (.967 SV%) in a 5-1 win over the New York Rangers. In his last three games (3-0-0), Luukkonen has an impressive 2.00 GAA and .939 SV%. The Sabres enter Friday's game as -148 home favourites against a struggling Pittsburgh Penguins team on a five-game losing skid (0-5-0).
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Murashov will start in Buffalo on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: The Penguins are having a miserable season, but the lightly used Murashov has shown some encouraging signs between the pipes. The 22-year-old rookie goalie had a poor outing, allowing four goals on 29 shots (.862 SV%) in a 4-3 loss to the Nashville Predators. The loss ended a solid three-game stretch for Murashov (2-1-0), in which he saved 91 of 98 shots (.929 SV%). The Penguins enter Friday's game as +126 road underdogs against the Buffalo Sabres.

2026-11-27.homeNewsDetails: Jarry will start vs. Seattle on Friday.
2026-11-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After a disappointing introduction to the Oilers in the 2025-26 season, Jarry has been reliable on most nights in 2026-27. That said, he struggled in his most recent game, allowing four goals on 27 shots (.852 SV%) in a 5-4 shootout loss to the St. Louis Blues. It snapped a six-game stretch in which Jarry allowed three or fewer goals in each game (4-0-2). The Oilers enter Friday's outing as -203 home favourites against the Seattle Kraken, who are coming off a 3-1 loss to the Chicago Blackhawks.
2026-11-27.awayNewsDetails: Grubauer will start in Edmonton on Friday.
2026-11-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Grubauer has had ups and downs in the 2026-27 season and is coming off a poor performance, allowing four goals on 28 shots (.857 SV%) in a 4-3 loss to the San Jose Sharks. Still, the 35-year-old German goalie has a decent 2.59 GAA and .908 SV% in five November appearances (1-3-0). The Kraken enter Friday's game as +182 road underdogs against the Edmonton Oilers.
